title: Above the Crowd Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: 'Above The Crowd' in Seaside's premier location! This luxury penthouse offers stunning Gulf views, beautiful decor, and spacious living complete with a balcony!
description_expanded: Description25 CENTRAL SQUARE, UNIT 3011 QUEEN, 1 DOUBLE BED, 1 JUNIOR TWIN BUILT-IN BUNKSFront-Row Living Above Seaside Town CenterWelcome to Above The Crowd, an elevated Seaside, Florida vacation rental designed for guests who want to be in the center of it all—without sacrificing comfort or views. This stunning two-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath luxury penthouse sleeps up to six guests and sits directly above Seaside’s iconic Town Center. From this prime perch, enjoy sweeping views of the Gulf of Mexico and instant access to Seaside’s restaurants, boutiques, events, and beach pavilions.Airy Living Spaces with Coastal StyleUpon entry, the open and light-filled living area immediately sets the tone. Designed with relaxed coastal charm, the space features comfortable seating and a flat-screen TV—perfect for unwinding after a day spent at the beach or exploring Scenic Highway 30A. The fully equipped kitchen includes bar seating for three, making it easy to gather for casual meals or morning coffee.Step outside onto the covered balcony, where Adirondack seating for four invites you to linger. From here, enjoy views overlooking the Seaside Amphitheater and glimpses of the Gulf shimmering in the distance—an ideal spot for sunset cocktails, people-watching, or live music drifting up from the square below.Upstairs Retreats with Character & ComfortA beautifully crafted staircase leads to the upper level, where the primary queen bedroom offers a peaceful escape above the energy of Town Center. Vaulted ceilings, custom built-in storage, and a charming vanity desk enhance both function and style. Large windows frame stunning Gulf views, while a cozy bay window nook creates the perfect spot to relax and take it all in. Privacy curtains allow the space to transform into a tranquil retreat at night.Also on the upper level is a second bedroom with a comfortable double bed, accessible via an outdoor patio. This private outdoor space includes seating for relaxing under the stars and enjoying the coastal evening air. Back inside, just off the stair landing, a thoughtfully designed junior bunk nook with twin-over-twin beds is built into the hallway—perfect for younger guests.Both sleeping areas share a beautifully renovated full bathroom featuring a double vanity and a luxurious glass-enclosed walk-in shower.An Unmatched Seaside Vacation ExperiencePerfectly positioned above the action yet offering elevated privacy, Above The Crowd combines luxury, location, and unforgettable Gulf views in one exceptional Seaside penthouse. Whether you’re here to enjoy live music, boutique shopping, beach days, or simply relax high above it all, this one-of-a-kind vacation rental delivers a stay you won’t soon forget.* Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter.FEATURES:1,115 square feet of well-appointed living spaceApprox. 167 feet / 1-minute walk to beach access at Coleman Pavilion Seaside BeachTwo flat-screen Smart TVs and one Blu-Ray playerBeautiful Gulf and beach viewsOverlooks Seaside Town Center and the Seaside AmphitheaterHigh-speed, password-secured wireless internetElevator access to the third-floor entryParking: one parking pass included; shared parking available behind 25 Central and along Quincy Circle on a first-come, first-served basis; additional vehicles may park in paid public parking areas for a daily rateAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityGolf cart policy: golf carts are considered vehicles; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited—special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets permitted
